title: OTWD governed list translation
description: The labels and descriptions of one governed list in one language other than en-AU, the reference language. It lives at schema/i18n/<language>/<list file>, for example schema/i18n/de/facilities.json. It holds text only, keyed by code: codes, safety flags, attributes, ranks, passages and mappings stay in the reference list, so a translation can never change what a code means. Every code it names must exist in the reference list, and a code it leaves out falls back to the base language and then to en-AU.

list.description: The governed list this file translates. The file name is the list's file name.

language.description: The BCP 47 tag of the language the text is in. It matches the name of the folder the file is in, and it is never en-AU.

reference_version.description: The version of the reference list the text was translated from. Entries added to the reference list after it show in en-AU until the translation catches up.

entries.description: The translated text, keyed by the code it belongs to.

TranslatedEntry.description: The text of one entry in the translation's language. Give the label, the description or both. Anything left out falls back.

attributes.description: Descriptions of the entry's facility attributes, keyed by attribute name. Each name must be an attribute of the entry in the reference list.
